home.themesSubtitle: Every design is drawn and animated with care. Swipe to see more.
home.noThemes: Our first designs are on their way. See you soon.
home.step1Body: A design that feels like you, and a package that fits your occasion.
home.step2Body: Names, date and venue, and see your complete invitation before paying.

home.faq1q: How long does the invitation stay available?
home.faq1a: Your invitation stays available to guests for 30 days from the moment it is published, and you can contact us to extend it.
home.faq2q: Can I see my invitation before paying?
home.faq2a: Yes. After you add the names and details, you see your complete invitation as a preview, then decide.
home.faq3q: How do I share the invitation?
home.faq3a: After payment you get a private link to your invitation to send on WhatsApp or any app.
home.faq4q: Can the invitation be changed after publishing?
home.faq4a: Contact us and we will make the correction for you.
